## What I've changed

Describe the change and why it matters. State what was actually verified, not just what was intended.

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] I've run the relevant tests and reported their results.
- [ ] I've distinguished **in-game verified**, **offline tested**, **inferred** and **unverified** claims.
- [ ] I've checked sensitive/private and copyrighted material before publication.
- [ ] I've preserved existing working state and clearly described any restoration or rollback.
- [ ] I've used **first-person singular** for my project decisions, listening, driving and test approvals ("I / my"), rather than calling myself "the owner" or "the user". Technical ownership and separate automation roles remain accurately named.

## Public development progress

For **each completed milestone or significant verified event**, I will update the [development progress log](../docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md) in the same PR and keep the concise [README summary](../README.md#development-progress) current:

- [ ] I've updated the development progress log with a public-facing result, date, evidence link, limitations and next step, and adjusted the short README summary if needed.
- [ ] This is not a significant progress event, or the milestone is still ongoing. I've explained why the progress log and README summary do not need updating below.
